review:
Beheaded is a dark jungle slot on a 5x4 grid with a Cut Reel mechanic: winning symbols, and the symbols beneath them on each reel, are removed and the reels drop. A progression bar beneath the grid collects symbols through five levels, and each new level adds free spins.

Three Soul Wilds have their own collectors, which gather souls from dropped premium symbols after a win. Ayahuasca Spins lead into the top-tier Tzantza Spins. Nolimit rates it Insane volatility, its highest rating, and caps it at 15,950x. It's not a slot for short sessions.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
